stories.title: Git Patches Flaw That Lets Malicious Repositories Execute Code During Recursive Clones
stories.description: Git fixes six flaws, including CVE-2026-111760, which lets malicious repositories execute code during recursive clones via submodule hooks.

stories.title: Exploited Outlook Zero-Day Among 1,094 Flaws Patched by Microsoft
stories.description: CVE-2026-124194 is the Outlook zero-day for which Microsoft says it’s aware of active exploitation.

stories.title: SGLang RCE Exploit Breaches NEAR AI, Steals Data From 18 Agents and About 100 Users
stories.description: An attacker exploited an SGLang RCE flaw at NEAR AI, stealing account and agent data and potentially viewing confidential AI requests.

stories.title: Microsoft Patch Tuesday November 2027 , (Tue, Nov 10th)
stories.description: Microsoft continues its AI-induced patch surge, addressing 1,260 different vulnerabilities this month. 68 of these vulnerabilities are considered critical. 167 of the vulnerabilities are Chromium issues affecting Microsoft Edge.

stories.title: Microsoft November 2026 Patch Tuesday Fixes 1,093 Vulnerabilities, Including Outlook Zero-Day
stories.description: Microsoft’s November 2026 Patch Tuesday release covers 1,093 newly released vulnerabilities, including an Outlook spoofing flaw marked as exploited.

stories.title: BYOD Ransomware Group Allegedly Claims Toyota Data Breach
stories.description: The BYOD ransomware group has allegedly claimed a Toyota data breach, saying it obtained personal information and access involving kiosk devices. A supplied screenshot shows a Toyota listing updated on November 10, 2026.

stories.title: Hackers Exploit Critical Xen Orchestra Auth Bypass Flaw to Gain Admin Access
stories.description: Hackers are exploiting a critical Xen Orchestra authentication bypass that can grant admin access and lead to XCP-ng node takeover.

stories.title: Adobe Patches 110 Vulnerabilities Across 9 Products
stories.description: Adobe has fixed vulnerabilities in AEM, Premiere, Photoshop, After Effects, Connect, Audition, Dimension, Content Credentials SDK, and Media Encoder.

stories.title: Three China-Nexus Espionage Campaigns Linked Through Sparrow Malware Ecosystem
stories.description: Check Point links three espionage clusters to the Sparrow malware ecosystem, targeting telecom, government, and other sectors across three continents.

stories.title: Hackers Can Exploit SAP PROXYGATE and ICM2SHELL Flaws for Unauthorized Full System Access
stories.description: SAP has released fixes for PROXYGATE and ICM2SHELL, critical security flaws that could let attackers take control of SAP systems without signing in.

stories.title: Railway Reveals How Hackers Used AI Agents to Steal API Keys and Rack Up $740,000 in Charges
stories.description: Railway has revealed how an attacker used AI agents, a build system flaw, and cloud access mistakes to steal customer secrets and generate an estimated $740,000 in unauthorized charges.

stories.title: Software Transparency Is Changing: Allan Friedman on SBOM, AI BOMs and What Comes Next
stories.description: SBOM pioneer Allan Friedman joined the SecurityWeek Podcast to discuss why knowing what is inside software is only the beginning, how AI is complicating software supply chain visibility, and what organizations should be doing with SBOM data once they have it.

stories.title: Google Widens Gemini 4 Carbon Access After AI Agents Verify Signal Code
stories.description: Google opened Carbon to paying developers and businesses as DeepMind used agents built on it to prove libsignal security guarantees.

stories.description: Google said today it worked with industry partners to dismantle a botnet made up of more than 1.3 million Android TV set-top boxes that ship with malicious software which secretly rents the user's Internet connection out to strangers and conducts advertising…
